LANDING_SUBTITLE: Free AI-powered personal trainer. Track calories, plan workouts, and reach your goals — no ads, no subscriptions, ever.
LANDING_FEATURES_TITLE: Everything you need to transform your body
LANDING_FEATURE_AI_DESC: A virtual trainer that analyzes your eating habits and adjusts your macronutrients every 7 days to keep you progressing toward your goal.
LANDING_FEATURE_CALORIES_DESC: Log every meal with detailed macronutrient breakdowns. Track proteins, carbs, and fats against your personalized daily targets.
LANDING_FEATURE_BARCODE_DESC: Scan any product barcode to instantly log it. No manual searching — just point your camera and go.
LANDING_FEATURE_WORKOUT_DESC: Create workout plans, log your results, and track progress with detailed statistics over time.
LANDING_FEATURE_OFFLINE_DESC: Install as an app on your phone. Track meals and workouts even without internet connection.
LANDING_FEATURE_FREE_DESC: No hidden costs, no premium tiers, no ads. Every feature is available to everyone, completely free. Forever.
LANDING_HOW_TITLE: Three steps to your new body
LANDING_STEP_1_DESC: Sign up with Google in one click. Set your height, weight, and basic info.
LANDING_STEP_2_DESC: Choose to build muscle, lose weight, or recompose. The AI Coach calculates your perfect macronutrients.
LANDING_STEP_3_DESC: Log meals and workouts daily. Every 7 days, the coach analyzes your progress and adjusts your plan.
LANDING_OPENSOURCE_DESC: Juicify is fully open source. Inspect the code, contribute, or self-host your own instance.
LANDING_FINAL_DESC: Let AI guide your fitness journey. Free, private, and effective.
